643-864-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-864-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

176-4875-6797.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4875-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

539-997-3821-4679-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-997-3821-4679-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 2.

513-1003-3558.easyPrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana cost {0} must be in your hand with the other being on the battlefield.
513-1003-3558.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

2099-2486-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-2486-4694-7306.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

654-3277-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-3277-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Izzet Chronarch and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-3277-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Izzet Chronarch and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

277-2577-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-2577-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-801-2466-3249.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

277-851-2557-3129-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

5571-6797-7666--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2388-3259-4885.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

889-1618-2440-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Deekah
889-1618-2440-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Deekah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
889-1618-2440-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Deekah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1394-2034-2060-2265-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Hardened Scales.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Hardened Scales.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

465-2921-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-2921-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

1692-2489-3277-3732.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1692-2489-3277-3732.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1692-2489-3277-3732.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch with haste.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

586-2816-7070.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Gix.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Gix.
The Umbral Mantle ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1978-5056-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Neurok Transmuter by paying {U}, causing Avatar Kyoshi to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Repeat from step 3.

2757-3525-5251.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

4211-5660-6010.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Tormod's Crypt enters, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling an opponent's graveyard.
Resolve the Builder's Talent trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3384-4067-6254-6827.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
3384-4067-6254-6827.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Spider-Gwen.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
Repeat.

1939-1981-4416-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1939-1981-4416-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2770-6676.notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
2770-6676.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Demonic Pact to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.

uses.n: Sea Gate Restoration // Sea Gate, Reborn

1561-2836-6624.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1561-2836-6624.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw half your library and lose half your life total, rounding up each time.
Cast Sea Gate Restoration by paying {4}{U}{U}{U}, causing you to draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your hand. When you attempt to draw from an empty library this way, you will win the game due to Laboratory Maniac.

2043-2499-6252.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Boommobile that is a 1/1 Soldier artifact creature.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2043-2499-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2018-5231-6288.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding {R}.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding {R}.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat.

1274-3330-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3330-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2792-2821-5921-5970-6120.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to six other lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.

Activate up to six lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Minamo and up to six other lands.
Holding priority, activate Minamo and up to six other lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping Minamo and up to six other lands.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Bottomless Pool by paying {U}, unlocking it.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Repeat.

1116-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1116-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Sek'Kuar and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Graveborn, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

618-2178-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature with power 1 or greater.
618-2178-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control that has power 1 or greater with haste.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the creature token's power.
Repeat.

440-646-4277.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-646-4277.description:
Activate Words of Worship twice by paying {2}.
Attempt to draw a card, instead gaining 5 life due to Words of Worship.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers, causing you to pay {3} to gain 5 life due to Words of Worship and draw two cards.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers, holding priority, activate Cadaverous Bloom twice by exiling two cards from your hand, adding {4}.
Activate Words of Worship by paying {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {3} to gain 5 life due to Words of Worship and draw two cards.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may pay additional mana into Well of Lost Dreams to draw more cards, which can be exiled by Cadaverous Bloom for near-infinite black and/or green mana.

2014-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Yosei, adding {1}.
When Yosei dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Yosei enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing target opponent to skip their next untap step, and tapping five permanents that opponent controls.
Repeat from step 1 for each remaining opponent.
Repeat for each remaining opponent, and during each of your turns.

Tolsimir Wolfblood does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1337-2534.description:

If you control two Voja tokens, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Tolsimir Wolfblood.
Repeat.

67-2292-4681.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 2.
Repeat.

2129-3373.notablePrerequisites:
Scytheclaw attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill the creature with Scytheclaw attached.
2129-3373.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Scytheclaw attached.
Scytheclaw triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2773-3748.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Hornet Nest indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Hornet Nest.
2773-3748.description:
Give Hornet Nest indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Hornet Nest.
Hornet Nest triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, causing the Insect to deal one damage to Hornet Nest.
Repeat from step 3.

1302-1738.notablePrerequisites:

1302-1738.description:
Activate Catapult Captain by paying {2}{B}, tapping it, and sacrificing Serra Avatar, causing target opponent with a lower life total than you to lose life equal to its toughness.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

224-765-1257.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

232-3593-4359-5147.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Priest of Urabrask onto the battlefield.
Priest of Urabrask triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna onto the battlefield.
Garna's enter the battlefield ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Garna, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Garna ability, returning all creature cards put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

856-1201-1651-3129.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Food tokens, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Caludron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
